answer: Seal the bond to a hardware root and cut it by 10 POA for every claim that fails verification. A basalt miner with a single root can back one identity and no more, since a second account needs a second physical chip. Take the concrete case: 400 clones need 400 machines, which costs more than the 400 tasks they would have to win, so the gale of fake accounts dies at the hardware line before the first thread pays out.
